state.success: When target tauntTimer is zero, Cmd_settaunt writes target tauntTimer = 2 and target tauntTimer2 = 2, then advances five bytes. It performs no Random() call.
state.duplicate: When target tauntTimer is nonzero, Cmd_settaunt takes the encoded failure pointer and performs no setter-local write or Random() call.

effectScript.ppAndRng: Both the successful and already-taunted paths first run ppreduce and accuracycheck. Cmd_settaunt itself has no Random() call; source places accuracycheck before the setter, so the setter supplies neither an accuracy roll nor any other local RNG draw.

admission.manualSelection: TrySetCantSelectMoveBattleScript rejects a selected power-0 move when active tauntTimer is nonzero, choosing BattleScript_SelectingNotAllowedMoveTaunt in an ordinary battle and the Palace-specific selection script in Palace. A damaging move (power nonzero) does not satisfy this Taunt predicate.
admission.actionCanceler: CANCELER_TAUNTED blocks an executing power-0 current move when attacker tauntTimer is nonzero, marks usedTauntedMove, cancels multi-turn moves, and branches to BattleScript_MoveUsedIsTaunted.
admission.limitations: CheckMoveLimitations marks every power-0 slot when MOVE_LIMITATION_TAUNT is requested and that battler's tauntTimer is nonzero. It does not mark damaging slots for Taunt; its independent later Encore and Choice predicates combine masks.
admission.struggle: AreAllMovesUnusable uses MOVE_LIMITATIONS_ALL. When every slot is unavailable it selects MOVE_STRUGGLE, clears noValidMoves, sets HITMARKER_NO_PPDEDUCT, and targets Struggle.

lifetime.battleInit: BattleStartClearSetData / BattleIntroGetMonsData initialize battle state before action selection; active status2 is set to zero, and active DisableStruct data is initialized independently of the status2 field.
lifetime.endTurn: ENDTURN_TAUNT decrements target tauntTimer once per end-turn pass if it is nonzero. The source has no tauntTimer2 decrement at that site; tauntTimer2 is written by Cmd_settaunt.
lifetime.switch: SwitchInClearSetData clears the active DisableStruct bytewise, then restores only listed Baton-Pass fields; neither Taunt timer is restored. It also resets gLastMoves for the replacing active battler.
lifetime.batonPass: Baton Pass preserves only listed DisableStruct fields (substitute HP, sure-hit battler, Perish Song timers, and escape-prevention battler), so both Taunt timer fields are cleared.
lifetime.faint: FaintClearSetData clears the active DisableStruct bytewise and resets gLastMoves.

boundedRemainder: The OFF manifest exposes framebuffer hashes, active HP/PP/current move/RNG, status2, controller state, and built-party checksums, but not gBattlescriptCurrInstr, gBattlerTarget, tauntTimer, tauntTimer2, gLastMoves, selected-move scripts, noValidMoves, HITMARKER_NO_PPDEDUCT, result flags, or RNG attribution. The trace publicly proves the success and blocked-status text windows, Taunt's two PP reductions, forced Struggle with no Splash PP loss, persistence to a following decision, and later Splash PP use after expiry. Exact timer values, target ownership, pointer/PC, action-admission internals, switch/faint/Baton-Pass clearing, and setter-local RNG absence are source-pinned only; this does not claim a live switch, faint, Baton Pass, Palace selection, or a timer value from public output. This is evidence only and adds no production registration.
